test_title: PYST 9: SSC CHSL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: If 3 April 1996 was Wednesday, then what was the day of the week on 7 April 2001?
solution: Given: **3 April 1996** was Wednesday. Now, 1996 to 2001 = 5 Years (4 Ordinary Year and 1 Leap Year). And, In 5 Years = 1 Leap year and 4 Ordinary Year. So, 1 Leap Year has 2 odd days, And, 4 Ordinary Year has 4 odd days.
